messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: automatic promotion for change-window 'v1.43.x' blocked due to CI pipeline failure: build 4012 failed artifact-verify step (checksum mismatch reported). Auto-promo paused.
Maya: Ugh. Which artifact failed? frontend bundle or server binary?
Ethan: Server binary. Logs say uploaded size differs between mirrors; mirror-c reports truncated file.
ops-bot: Incident ticket CLOUD-11299 opened for mirror-c partial uploads in us-east-1. Noted on release-blocker.
Maya: Change window ends in 35m. Options: reupload and rerun CI (~20m) or pin and promote last-stable (v1.42.9). Thoughts?
QALead: Tests failing include Upload.test_integrity and Smoke.test_startup. If we pin, we should retest post-promote.
ReleaseManager: Prefer reupload since it's a candidate release. If reupload fails twice, fallback to pin. Approve retry plan.
Ethan: I'll trigger republish with enforced single-part upload for this binary and verify sha256 after. Command: `./tools/publish --file server.tgz --verify-sha`
deploybot: Note: auto-promo remains BLOCKED until artifacts verified across all mirrors. Manual promote allowed with explicit ReleaseManager approval.
Ethan: Republish attempt 1 done; local checksum matches. Starting CI rerun.
QALead: CI rerun started by Ethan, pipeline 4013. ETA ~10m.
ops-bot: Mirror-c currently reporting high put latency; retries may be needed.
Maya: If CI green, we should delay full promotion by 15m and run a 2% canary. Reduced blast radius.
ReleaseManager: Agreed. If CI green, promote with 2% canary and 15m observation.
deploybot: Pipeline 4013 green; artifact checksums verified on mirrors a,b,c. Canary deploy at 2% initiated.
QALead: Canary smoke passed for 12m. No integrity errors observed.
Ethan: Noted truncated-upload pattern in logs: multipart part 2 sometimes returns 0 bytes on high-concurrency uploads. I'll add a guard to uploader to checksum each part and retry. Creating PR now.
Maya: Promote to 100% after canary window? We still have 10m left in the change window. Suggest finishing within window and monitor.
ReleaseManager: Proceed to full promote at end of canary. Leave auto-promo blocked until mirrors show stable PUT success rate <0.5% for 1h. Postmortem task to improve uploader and mirror retries assigned to Ethan.
deploybot: Full rollout completed. Manual override recorded: `manual_promote_by=Maya; reason=artifact_reupload_success`. Auto-promo status: BLOCKED.
ops-bot: CLOUD-11299 updated: mirror-c backlog cleared, provider investigating intermittent partial PUTs.
Maya: Adding release note: "Promoted v1.43.0 after artifact reupload due to transient mirror truncation; follow-up: harden uploader and add per-part checksums."
ReleaseManager: Closing hold for this window. Thanks team. Reminder: follow-up PR and postmortem required.
